about_the_game:
One day, the illness came. But here, it never left.

Trapped, the world was reshaped by it.

Long ago, you arrived at what might be the last quarantined city, New Horizon. The only work you could find is Crow — body collector. You'll do essential work, the Military assured.

Now, it's time to start another day. You force yourself awake, rising from the dreamless void of slumber.

Who are you, Crow?

Wishlist Crow's so you don't miss out on the full game in 2026!

Prologue: Welcome to a Collector's Life

In the Crow's Requiem Prologue Demo you will play as Fisher — a veteran Body Collector living in the quarantined city of New Horizon for the last half-decade or so. 

In it, you will:

  • 💀 Choose your Crow Archetype;

  • 💀 Receive 6 Body Collection Requests;

  • 💀 Do the Work in the Collection Mini-Game *condition may vary!

  • 💀 Explore Zone 1 of New Horizon in the MAP UI;

  • 💀 Meet 8 of its NPC Citizens, ALLY with them — or EXPLOIT their trust.

  • 💀 Carve your way towards different endings.

Will you survive the Plaguelands?

The CITY

Explore New Horizon and its forgotten shopping malls, where believers search for holy signs on dirty napkins. Or, enter lawless compounds where a gun speaks louder than authority.

REMEMBER, COLLECTOR: you are one of the few in this quarantined city who still see others face-to-face daily.

To reach your requested collections, you will enter temples, compounds, barracks, and even stranger places. Be ready for anything.

The FACTIONS & CITIZENS

Interact with the Military Anarchist and Cultist factions who split control over the city. Do their bidding loyally or double-cross each fool who crosses your path.

From mad cultists to corrupt officials, down-on-their-luck civilians to rebellious artistic anarchists, each will see you through the filter of their plans and creeds. 

Your CHOICES & JOURNEY

The city and its inhabitants will remember your actions, so choose carefully how you'll deal with favors and threats, friend and foe. Carve your way towards multiple endings where you are the driving force of unforgettable consequences.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains violent, quarantine, pandemic, political, religious, physical and mental health, and death themes. While this content is included purposefully for narrative and experiential reasons, we encourage players' discretion.

  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 1650 / AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible audio device

short_description: The world is sick — and you are the body collector in this Pandemicpunk cRPG. Take the role of Fisher, a veteran Crow, and take your first steps into the City. Collect the dead; or risk joining them in the first two days of your Crow's Requiem dark work.

English*, Portuguese - Brazil*
